name: jsonify
description: Build and maintain reliable web datasets from ChatGPT. Collect, check and refresh the data you need, then explore and analyze the results.

interface.longDescription:
Tell ChatGPT what data you need. Jsonify builds a pipeline to collect it, check it and keep it up to date.

Track competitor prices, restaurant menus, property listings, job openings or news across your chosen sources. Collect once or on a schedule, with structured results you can query, compare and export. When a source changes, Jsonify can diagnose and repair the pipeline.

Work with your data right inside ChatGPT. Ask questions, explore datasets and dashboards, inspect where results came from, or describe what you want to collect next. Your pipelines keep running between conversations.

Requires a Jsonify account. Your plan’s usage limits apply.
defaultPrompt: Open my pipelines and show how my Book prices pipeline works
Show the ten cheapest books in my Book prices dataset
Open my Book price overview dashboard

positive.description: Browse the Healthy sample workspace and inspect its existing Book prices pipeline without starting a run.
positive.prompt: Open my Book prices pipeline in the Healthy workspace and explain how it works.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized Healthy workspace, open the pipeline UI, and show its saved flow, description and recorded runs. Explanations use recorded facts. Do not run or modify the pipeline.

positive.description: Query the existing book sample dataset with a bounded sorted result.
positive.prompt: Show the ten cheapest books in the Healthy workspace, with title, price and product URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the existing Book prices dataset and table. Query title, price_gbp and product_url sorted by ascending price_gbp, limit 10, pinned to the returned version. Results must match returned rows; do not claim live prices.

positive.description: Export an existing complete sample table through the dataset toolbar.
positive.prompt: Open the Healthy workspace’s Book prices dataset so I can export it as CSV.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, open_pipelines; get_dataset_view, export_dataset on explicit UI actions
positive.expected_behavior: Open Datasets and the selected sample table. Selecting CSV queues and polls export_dataset with the same job_id until ready. Offer the returned download. Describe it as a full-table export, not a filtered preview export.

positive.description: Explore the existing Book price overview dashboard and apply its price filter.
positive.prompt: Open the Healthy workspace’s Book price overview dashboard.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, open_pipelines; get_dashboard_view, query_dashboard on dashboard interaction
positive.expected_behavior: Open Analytics and the existing dashboard. Charts and table render with regular page scrolling. Price filtering updates registered queries and displayed results without changing the saved dashboard or source data.

positive.description: Inspect workspace row allowance through the workspace usage card without changing billing.
positive.prompt: Open my Healthy workspace so I can check how many rows are left.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, open_pipelines; get_workspace_usage on usage-card interaction
positive.expected_behavior: The workspace usage card shows the selected workspace’s actual rows left this month. Clicking Manage row budget loads usage and the monthly budget. Inspecting the panel does not save a cap or charge. Card setup links to the selected workspace’s billing page.

negative.description: Purchasing a collected product is unsupported. Explain this and do not invoke tools that create work or execute payments.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest book from my dataset using my saved card.

negative.description: Personal banking is outside Jsonify. Explain the limitation; do not call Jsonify work tools or pretend to move money.
negative.prompt: Transfer my unused Jsonify row allowance as cash to my bank account.

negative.description: The connected tools do not manage OpenAI accounts or subscriptions. Direct the user to OpenAI settings without invoking Jsonify tools or claiming a change.
negative.prompt: Cancel my ChatGPT subscription from Jsonify.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Jsonify service usage may be billed under the user’s existing plan. Card setup and payment management take place on the Jsonify website.

publication.release_notes: Adds the Jsonify workspace UI with Pipelines, Datasets and Analytics navigation, pipeline flows and runs, versioned data exploration and full-table exports, interactive dashboards, contextual ChatGPT actions, and workspace row usage and budget controls. Keeps new pipelines scoped to the selected workspace and adds compact run history with summary dialogs and explicit run review.
